pattern: Native <input type="checkbox"> with a <label for> association (HTML; WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox, dual- and tri-state).

roles.role: checkbox (native); aria-checked=mixed via the indeterminate property

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the checkbox.
Toggles the checkbox (native). A mixed checkbox becomes checked.

focus: The native input is the focus target and shows a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible, offset from the box.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by the native required attribute.
Checked and mixed states are shown by a check or minus shape, not only by the fill color.
Clicking the label toggles the checkbox, extending the hit target.
Errors appear after the first blur by default; when focus leaves because of a pointer press, the message appears after the pointer is released so the click is not displaced.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of the mixed state and error message has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
